stories.label: Iran war Day 6: US shifts to 2,000-lb bombs, death toll past 1,000
stories.summary: Day 6: US shifting from precision munitions to 2,000-lb bombs. Death toll past 1,000. Submarine sank warship off Sri Lanka. Spain defiant. IRGC wartime lead. Khamenei funeral postponed. CIA back-channel signalling.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 6: Global south fuel crisis deepens, 15% tariff imminent
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed. Pakistan fuel emergency. Cuba blackout linked to fuel shortages. Bessent confirms 15% global tariff this week. Markets volatile. Bangladesh power rationing.

stories.label: Lebanon: 72+ killed since Monday, Macron urges restraint
stories.summary: Israeli strikes killed 72+ since Monday. Macron urged Netanyahu against ground offensive. All south of Litani ordered evacuated. Hezbollah retaliating with drone swarms.

stories.label: Gaza: Aid collapses under Iran war cover — siege tightens unseen
stories.summary: Finally covered after 6-cycle gap. Fewer Israeli strikes but aid entirely cut off. Crossings sealed. Siege tightening while world watches Iran. Humanitarian agencies cannot reach populations.

stories.label: Nepal votes March 5 — first election since Gen Z protests toppled government
stories.summary: Election is March 5. First since Gen Z protests. Watch for results, youth turnout, whether new parties break through.

stories.label: US Congress moves on war powers as Iran escalation deepens
stories.summary: Senate war powers resolution by Tim Kaine. Dems say troop deployment 'more likely.' Senate likely to reject bid to curb Trump. Kurdish forces weighing ground offensive with US arms.

stories.label: Nestlé sells baby cereal with 15% sugar in Africa, zero in Europe
stories.summary: Public Eye investigation: Nestlé's Cerelac baby cereal contains up to 15% added sugar in Africa, zero in Europe.

stories.label: China sustains hours-long laser link with satellite 40,000km up
stories.summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences sustained high-speed laser communication with geostationary satellite for hours.

stories.label: AI translations injecting fabricated information into Wikipedia
stories.summary: AI-translated Wikipedia articles swapping sources, adding unsourced sentences, inserting paragraphs from unrelated material.

stories.label: AI avatar 'Gaitana' running to represent Indigenous voters in Colombia
stories.summary: Digital AI avatar 'Gaitana' is public stand-in for two real Indigenous candidates, used to seek consensus from communities.

stories.label: PM Abiy warns Eritrea: next attempt to harm Ethiopia 'will be the last'
stories.summary: PM Abiy warned Eritrea. Ethiopia-Kenya agreed joint military operations. Not yet covered but worth watching.

stories.label: Sun's 'glitches' during quiet periods explained by scientists
stories.summary: Scientists used helioseismology to explain anomalous vibrations in the Sun during low activity.

stories.label: Lenovo ThinkPads score perfect 10/10 repairability from iFixit
stories.summary: First major laptop line to score 10/10 from iFixit. EU right-to-repair directive driving compliance.

stories.label: Ukrainian naval drones sink Russian LNG tanker in Mediterranean
stories.summary: Arctic Metagaz LNG tanker sunk between Libya and Malta by Ukrainian naval drones. Farthest-reaching Ukrainian maritime strike. Hits Russia's energy export capacity in European waters.

stories.label: UK arrests Labour MP's husband and two others for China espionage
stories.summary: Three men arrested in UK for spying for China, including husband of a Labour MP in the ruling party. Deepest known penetration of Chinese intelligence into British governing party.

stories.label: Cuba blackout leaves millions without power, may last 72 hours
stories.summary: Western Cuba including Havana blacked out. Crumbling grid, dwindling oil, US sanctions, Hormuz fuel disruption compound. Latest in pattern of island-wide outages.

stories.label: First wrongful death lawsuit against Google over Gemini AI chatbot
stories.summary: 36-year-old Florida man considered mass casualty attack and killed himself. Family sues Google, alleging Gemini fuelled delusional spiral. First wrongful death case over AI chatbot.

stories.label: Google ends 30% app store fee, opens to third-party stores
stories.summary: Google drops 30% Play Store commission and opens Android to third-party app stores. Forced by antitrust pressure and EU Digital Markets Act. Most significant crack in app store duopoly.

stories.label: Children's mole count halved in 25 years — sun campaigns measurably changing bodies
stories.summary: 25-year study of 4,000 Queensland children: average mole count dropped from 87 to 46 (47% reduction). Evidence that decades of sun protection campaigns are physically changing children's skin development.

stories.label: Khamenei succession: Mojtaba Khamenei frontrunner, funeral delayed
stories.summary: Funeral postponed amid bombardment. Mojtaba Khamenei frontrunner. IRGC wartime lead. Subsumed into main Iran war arc.

stories.label: Pakistan: Karachi shootings, visa suspension, nationwide protests
stories.summary: US Marines fired on protesters. Visas suspended. Watch for escalation.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: War continues with zero global attention. UK banning student visas for Sudan nationals. Need anchoring development to cover.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia: LNG tanker sunk in Mediterranean escalates maritime war
stories.summary: Russian LNG tanker Arctic Metagaz sunk in Mediterranean by Ukrainian drones. 288 missiles in February — 3-year high. Iran war diverting weapons from Ukraine.

stories.label: 1.1 million Filipino overseas workers at risk across Middle East
stories.summary: 1.1M Filipino OFWs — mostly women in domestic work — trapped across five war-affected countries.

stories.label: CBP used ad-tech data to track phones without warrants
stories.summary: Internal DHS document confirms CBP used ad ecosystem location data to track phones without warrants.

stories.label: FBI using AI as 'game changer' for hacking operations
stories.summary: FBI official called AI a 'game changer' for remote access operations.

stories.label: US government iPhone-hacking toolkit leaked to foreign spies
stories.summary: Coruna toolkit built for US government iPhone exploitation has reached foreign intelligence services.

stories.label: British lawyers to sue UAE and RSF leaders in UK courts
stories.summary: UK lawyers filing lawsuits against UAE and RSF leaders for war crimes.

stories.label: Chile's Kast halts transition over Chinese subsea cable
stories.summary: Far-right president-elect Kast suspended handover over Chinese subsea cable project.
